FULL INGREDIENTS 
1. 200G Boiled Chickpea
2. 100G Boiled Beans 
3. 150G Paneer 
4. 2 Carrots
5. 1/2 Avocado 

RECIPE FOR GREEN GODDESS SAUCE 

1. Add yogurt+ coriander + Mint + Basils + parsley everything to a blender.
2. Blend until smooth, creamy and bright green
3. Add water & Salt little by little until you like 

FOR CHICKPEA CURRY
Marinate with mustard sauce & paprika… then cook it in a pan 
Add Gravy (Roasted & blended tomatoes & peppers for creamy texture add yogurt) 

#vegrecipe #richmeal #highprotein #paneer".
